Sub: - Deep Depression (Remnant of Severe Cyclonic Storm “Murasu”) over Coastal Andhra
Pradesh & adjoining east Telangana
The Deep Depression (Remnant of Severe Cyclonic Storm “Murasu”) over Coastal Andhra Pradesh
moved nearly north-northeastwards with a speed of 07 kmph during past 06 hours, and lay centered at
2330 hours IST of yesterday, the 03rd November, 2026 over Coastal Andhra Pradesh & adjoining east
Telangana, near Latitude 16.5°N and Longitude 80.1°E, about 40 km south-southwest of Nandigama
(Andhra Pradesh), 60 km west of Vijayawada (Andhra Pradesh), 80 km south of Khammam (Telangana),
and 150 km south-southwest of Bhadrachalam (Telangana).
It is likely to move nearly northwards and weaken into a depression (wind speed reaching 40-50 kmph
gusting to 60 kmph) by morning of today, the 4th November, 2026.
It is under the continuous surveillance of Doppler Weather Radars at Machilipatnam and Visakhapatnam.
